message.content: In early 1815 Marseilles, young sailor Edmond Dantès returns triumphant from a voyage, is poised to become captain of the *Pharaon* and marry his betrothed Mercédès—yet his rivals, the envious supercargo Danglars and the heartbroken Catalan Fernand—fuel a conspiracy against him after observing his joy and hearing rumors of a suspicious stop at Elba.
